scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dark dashboard with a restrained monochromatic blue palette (#4477AA) applied consistently across all panels; the self-referential color scatter plot plotting actual hex values is clever, though node labels at 9px push the legibility floor and typographic hierarchy between title and panel labels is modest.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: bar baseline at 0, both circle size scales use scaleSqrt, timeline y-domain is data-driven, HCL hue/lightness axes use semantically fixed bounds (0–360, 0–100), no dual axes or line-chart gap issues; minor: fgBars update omits key function but bins are positionally stable so no corruption occurs.
scores.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag correctly coalesces renders, but both brush handlers (timeline and color) invoke unthrottled bitFilter.set() — iterating all 34k blocks — on every mousemove, risking CPU jank on mid-range devices despite deferred drawing.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four cross-linked views (timeline brush, 60-node pre-baked network, hue/lightness color scatter, scrollable list) stay manageable because the layout groups them logically, the network uses a single blue hue avoiding color overload, and the force simulation is frozen before render so there is no animation chaos — the main friction is the color scatter's axes requiring a moment to parse.
